claim_tested: C30 (empirical core of the V2a lower-bound proof)

scripts.purpose: Analytic (Route 1) cross-check of ht_derivative pipeline against a hand-derived closed form for finite trig-sum profiles; also sanity-checks the endpoint=False grid convention against the known endpoint-duplication bug.

Crux test: delta-independence of the bump-induced depression, for a bump centered exactly at the measurement point x0 ('centered') and for a bump offset by delta/2 from x0 ('offset', dilation-covariant).

Tests proportionality of a_min to local headroom (consequence a) and universality of the coefficient kappa across x0 and across 8 independent random base profiles spanning ~4.6 decades of headroom (consequence b).
Tests N-independence (consequence c) of the offset-construction coefficient C_phi at N=4096/8192/16384 (powers of 2) and N=10000/12000/15000 (non-powers of 2).

grid_convention: x = np.linspace(-L, L, N, endpoint=False); justified in checkpoint.md and replication.md — avoids the known endpoint-duplication period-mismatch bug recorded in PROTOCOL.md.

pre_registered_tolerances.width_independence: <2% relative RMS over >=1.5 decades of delta
pre_registered_tolerances.constant_value_vs_0.418: within 10% treated as supportive, not proof of same definition
pre_registered_tolerances.N_independence: <1% relative variation across N tested, including non-power-of-2
